context: A small audition room. Riku has been talked into trying out for a community theater play. Asuka, a friend of his mom's, is on the panel — purely by coincidence.
purpose: small-stakes audition — nervous teen, kind familiar judge

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: A small startled-pleased recognition — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real teen embarrassment — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日、来てくれて、本当にありがとう。
lines.en: Truly — thank you for coming today.
lines.style: A small professional pivot — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A small honest teen line — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: (small laugh) 審査員、一人だけ、足りなくて。
lines.en: (small laugh) They needed one more judge — that's all.
lines.style: A small explanation — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A small Kansai-Tokyo blend protest — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大丈夫。私、ちゃんと先生として、見るから。
lines.en: It's alright. I'll watch you — properly, as a teacher.
lines.style: A small steady reassurance — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: …(beat) 心配かけて、すみません。
lines.style: A small unexpected mature line — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いえいえ。…本当に、ゆっくり、やって。
lines.en: Not at all. …Really — take your time, do it.
lines.style: A small warm permission — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい…(small breath) 始めます。
lines.style: A small focused commitment — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 時間、ちゃんとあるから。
lines.style: A small final permission — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real beat. The audition under way.
